properties.description:
`Artifact.audience` records `consumer` or `internal`, set through `set_artifact_intent` alongside granularity and volatility. The `internal_only_delivery` finding then names a Requirement whose every DECLARED delivering artifact is internal, with none declared consumer. Per-requirement rather than aggregate, because accepting "this need is served by our own tooling on purpose" is a claim about one need. Never inferred from a path: a directory rule would encode one project's layout, which is the failure the requirement exists to prevent. An undeclared artifact is evidence of neither side and its count goes in the evidence.

WAS KNOWN INCOMPLETE, AND THE HOLE IS NOW CLOSED (2026-08-22, #296). This node used to end: "a design that has declared no audience anywhere is silent in every surfaced report, because vocabulary_coverage names unused node and edge TYPES but never unused PROPERTIES." That was true when written and is no longer. `vocabulary_coverage` now names the properties it counts, so a design that has declared no audience comes back as `build: node property Artifact.audience` — fixed at the root for every optional field in every project rather than special-cased for this one.

🛑 WHAT REMAINS TRUE, so this does not get rounded up to "closed": that naming rides the FLAT LIST, which is withheld unless asked for. The silence is REPORTABLE, not REPORTED — the default reply says the `build` domain's properties are under-filled without saying which one. `detect_internal_only_delivery` carries the same limit note, and `tests/internal_only_delivery.rs` pins both halves.

⚠️ AND REFLOW2 HAS NOT USED IT. `Artifact.audience` is 0 of 190 on this design: the field exists so a deliverable declares who it reaches, and not one of reflow2's own is classified. `rule:the-self-host-always-trails-what-it-teaches`, visible now instead of inferred.

AS-BUILT, recorded 2026-08-22 after `detect_gaps` reported this capability allocated to no component and realized by no artifact — both true of the RECORD and neither true of the code, which #295 shipped. Allocated to `cmp:artifact` (the declaring half) and `cmp:detect` (the reporting half); realized by `art:schema-build` (the property), `art:artifact` + `art:tools-built` + `art:service` (the write path), and `art:detect` (the finding).
properties.name: A deliverable declares who it is for, and a need nothing consumer-facing delivers is reported
